text: The Moss docs do not state an uptime percentage for Moss Inference, so there is no SLA figure to quote. The Inference overview (https://docs.moss.dev/docs/inference/overview) gives latency only: under 200 ms time to first token on moss/fastlane-1, and Moss Inference is in private beta. The pricing page (https://docs.moss.dev/docs/founding-agent/pricing) mentions "SLA guarantees" for the Enterprise plan but gives no percentage. Searches for uptime, availability and SLA found nothing further. For a committed figure, ask Moss directly through the portal at https://portal.usemoss.dev/.
